metadata.universe: Every symbol with stored equity/ETF or crypto OHLC; no active flag or watchlist restriction
metadata.cost_status: Configured assumptions; execution venue, fee tier and short financing not specified
metadata.period: Each instrument's full stored history; cross-instrument periods differ
metadata.annualisation: CAGR from elapsed calendar years; volatility/Sharpe use 252 equity sessions or 365 crypto days; zero cash return
metadata.position_model: One direction at a time; fixed units within a trade; next trade uses full current simulated equity; no portfolio allocation
metadata.benchmark: Buy at first stored close, hold to last close; adjusted equities, raw crypto; before execution costs
metadata.direction_views: Long and short contributions from the SAME two-sided run, not standalone one-direction simulations
